t: Appropriating $13,500, Public Works, Special Gas Tax, Ross Alley improvement.

Granting permission to Ross Alley Improvement Association to install movable bollards on Ross Alley to close said street to through traffic and to install various street amenities to beautify said street; and finding a public benefit accruing therefrom.
